integrity: First-publication date verified from arXiv version record; preceding Stirling moment identity and original spillage definition are credited. Finite checks supplement, but do not prove, the asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fixed k and positive fixed phi; no uniform result in changing-parameter regimes, no exact finite-sample total-variation optimum; originality not independently certified.
title: Sharp total-variation error for the binomial approximation to spillage laws
